deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Please note that these instructions are specific to Shopify's admin interface.
To embed a returns reason capture form into your Shopify returns flow, follow these steps:
1. Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Policies"
2. Click on the "Returns" tab and then click on the "Edit" button next to "Return policy"
3. Scroll down to the "Return reasons" section and click on the "Add return reason" button
4. Fill in the required fields for your return reason, including a name and description
5. Under the "Return form settings" section, toggle the switch to enable the return form
6. In the "Form fields" section, select the field type as "Text" and add a label for the returns reason capture form
7. Click on the "Save" button to save your changes
8. To display the returns reason capture form in your Shopify store's returns flow, you'll need to use Shopify's Liquid templating language.
